test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rajkumar Singhajit Singh, a leading exponent and guru of Indian classical Manipuri dance form, was awarded which of the following Indian civilian honours in 1986?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Shri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Guru Singhajit Singh **is well-known for his proficiency in the **Manipuri dance **style. He has also distinguished himself as a superb performer, choreographer, scholar, and artist with exceptional creative abilities.
 
• On May 1st, 1935,** Rajkumar Singhajit Singh** was born in **Manipur**.
 
• For his contributions to **Manipuri dance,** he received the **Padma Shri in 1986 **as well as the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1984.**
